correctness.rationale: Exact bijection: each tree has exactly one degree-two spoke and b−1 independent attachments, all uniform. Conditioning on whether two bridge spokes coincide gives respective shifted Bin(b−1,1/2) and Bin(b−2,1/2); the mixture collapses to an independent Bernoulli correction. Binomial unimodality proves the TV formula. All conditions b>=2, support endpoints and moments checked algebraically; exact rational pair enumeration b=2..6 reproduces all claims.

value.rationale: The latest literature expressly poses intersection counts of random spanning trees and remarks on fixed-small-part binomial behavior; the first nontrivial fixed part size two admits a natural exact distribution rather than merely an asymptotic one. The bridge-spoke structure exposes a rare collision event; the independently summed Bernoulli correction and closed exact TV rate provide a sharp finite-size explanation not obtained from simple normalization checks. Applies for arbitrarily large b and is not a one-off census.
